meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Discover, analyze, and prioritize keywords for SEO and GEO content strategies from a seed keyword or niche. Identifies high-value opportunities based on search volume, competition, intent, and business relevance. Generates topic clusters. For building a dated editorial calendar from your own Search Console data, use `content-planner` instead — this skill is seed-driven keyword discovery, not calendar scheduling. Use when asked to "find keywords", "keyword research", "keyword analysis", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", "content ideas from a seed", or any keyword discovery task.

copy.tagline: 从种子词发现高价值关键词和话题集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为网站或内容找到有搜索量的关键词
copy.tagline_en: Discover high-value keywords and topic clusters from a seed term
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find searchable keywords for your website or content

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的种子关键词或领域，生成关键词列表、判断搜索意图、评估竞争难度、计算机会分数，并整理成主题集群和报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“找关键词”、“关键词研究”、“搜索量”、“关键词难度”或“从种子词获取内容创意”时触发。

say.text: 帮我找“项目管理软件”的关键词机会。
say.note: Claude 会生成关键词列表并分析。

say.text: 分析“远程办公工具”的低竞争关键词。
say.note: Claude 会筛选低难度关键词。

say.text: 为“在线教育”做关键词研究，侧重商业意图。
say.note: Claude 会按商业意图分类。

howto.what_en: Claude generates keyword lists, classifies search intent, assesses difficulty, scores opportunities, and organizes them into topic clusters and reports based on your seed keyword or niche.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "find keywords", "keyword research", "keyword analysis", "search volume", "keyword difficulty", or "content ideas from a seed".

say_en.text: Find keyword opportunities for "project management software".
say_en.note: Claude will generate and analyze keywords.

say_en.text: Analyze low-competition keywords for "remote work tools".
Do keyword research for "online education" with commercial intent.
say_en.note: Claude will classify by commercial intent.
